title: Wi-Fi
noRadios: This router has no wireless hardware
noRadiosHint: No wireless card was found, or its driver isn't loaded.
noNetworks: No Wi-Fi networks on this radio

radio.countryHint: Two letters, e.g. US or DE. It decides the allowed channels and maximum power.
radio.dfs: Needs radar detection (DFS); slower to start
radio.consequenceRestart: Wi-Fi restarts and every wireless device drops for 10–30 seconds
radio.consequenceRollback: If the app can't reach the router within 90 seconds, the change is undone automatically

network.hiddenHint: Devices will have to type the name to join.

issues.ssid-too-long: The name can be at most 32 bytes
issues.key-required: This security type needs a password

network.consequenceRestart: This network restarts and its devices drop for 10–30 seconds
network.consequenceRollback: If the app can't reach the router within 90 seconds, the change is undone automatically
network.consequencePhone: Your phone is on this network: it will disconnect, and you'll rejoin with the new name and password
network.consequenceNoRollback: This can't be undone automatically: if the new settings are wrong, fix them over a cable

result.rolledBack: The router got no confirmation within 90 seconds and undid the change

reconnect.title: Rejoin Wi-Fi
reconnect.body: The router has the new Wi-Fi settings. Join the network below in your phone's Wi-Fi settings, then come back.
reconnect.step1: Open Settings → Wi-Fi on your phone
reconnect.step2: Choose the network above and enter the password
reconnect.step3: Come back to RouteLink once connected

scanHint: Devices on this radio may stutter briefly while it scans.

qr.title: Share Wi-Fi
qr.hint: Point a phone camera at the code to join.

macfilter.title: MAC Filter

modeHint.disable: Every device with the password can join.
modeHint.allow: Only the devices below can join this network.
modeHint.deny: The devices below can't join this network.

macfilter.randomHint: Phones often use a random address per network: add them while they are connected.

error.mac-invalid: The list has an invalid MAC address
error.allow-empty: An empty list would let nobody join
error.locks-out-phone: This would disconnect this phone from the network (and the app from the router)

macfilter.consequence: Devices that aren't allowed are disconnected and can't join again
macfilter.phoneConsequence: This phone is on this network: Wi-Fi restarts and the change is applied without the automatic undo

guest.title: Guest Network
guest.intro: A separate Wi-Fi for visitors: internet only, no access to your devices or the router's settings.
guest.notGateway: This router has Wi-Fi but doesn't route to the internet itself (an access point). Set up the guest network together with the main router; the app will support that later.
guest.isolateHint: Guests can't see each other's devices.
guest.deleteConsequence: Guests are disconnected; its Wi-Fi, addresses and firewall zone are removed
guest.createConsequence: Wi-Fi restarts for a moment; the router undoes it after 90 seconds if the app loses contact
